texts.preamble: C.Balakarthikeyan vs The Designated Officer on 25 September, 2025 Author: M.Dhandapani Bench: M.Dhandapani In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 25.09.2025 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice M.Dhandapani W.P.No.4750 of 2023 and W.M.P.No.4753 of 2023 C.Balakarthikeyan Vs. 1.The Designated Officer, Food Safety Department, Salem-1. 2.The Food Safety Officer, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration, (Food Safety Wing), Zone Iv (24-583), Salem Corporation, Salem District. Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution praying for issuance of a Writ of Certiorari, to call for the recor to the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 issued by the second responden quash the same.
texts.facts: This Writ Petition has been filed challenging the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 issued by the second respondent. 2. The petitioner is running a Alankar Zardha Scented Chewing Company and pursuant to inspection, the petitioners premises was sealed and goods were seized by the impugned order dated 28.07.2021. The premises was kept under lock and seal and the petitioner approached this Court by filing W.P.No.9370 of 2022 seeking to hand over the key of the petitioners premises by considering his representation.
texts.arguments: 3. Now, the petitioner is before this Court challenging the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 on the ground that the applicability of Section 3(1) (j) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, does not apply to the petitioners business.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. Now, the petitioner is before this Court challenging the seizure memo dated 28.07.2021 on the ground that the applicability of Section 3(1) (j) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, does not apply to the petitioners business.
